name.baseName: EPD of WIN WIN Mono Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic (PV) Modules

quantitativeReference.functionalUnitOrOther: 1 Wp (Watt-peak) of manufactured PV module, from cradle-to-grave, with activities needed for a reference service of life (RSL) of 30 years (≥80% of the labelled power output).

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: WIN's PV modules combine half-cell, 16 busbars and reflective wires as well as TOPCon technology to maximize module efficiency and improve temperature coefficients to perform well even in hot weather.
technology.technologicalApplicability: The function of the PV module is to generate electricity. For Building-Integrated-PV (BIPV) applications, there is an additional function of providing roofing to the building.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.useAdviceForDataSet: WIN's PV modules encompasses the life cycle stages of the product, from cradle to gate with options (A4-A5-B2)+C+D, including raw materials acquisition, transportation, manufacturing, delivery, installation, maintenance, waste disposal for end-of-life and benefits and loads after end-of-life.
